name: Civolution

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the Income phase of the 4th era, followed by final scoring

categories.label: Score track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước chung cuộc
categories.hint: Success points already on the score track (add 100 per completed lap) after the 4th-era income phase.

categories.label: Final: Technology track
categories.hint: units = number printed on your disc's space on the Technology track; pointsPerUnit = category value shown under that category in the final scoring area (or on its covering tile).

categories.label: Final: Prestige track
categories.hint: units = number printed on your disc's space on the Prestige track; pointsPerUnit = category value shown under that category in the final scoring area (or on its covering tile).

categories.label: Final: Knowledge track
categories.hint: units = number printed on your disc's space on the Knowledge track; pointsPerUnit = category value shown under that category in the final scoring area (or on its covering tile).

categories.label: Final: Construction track
categories.hint: units = number printed on your disc's space on the Construction track; pointsPerUnit = category value shown under that category in the final scoring area (or on its covering tile).

categories.label: Final: Culture track
categories.hint: units = number printed on your disc's space on the Culture track; pointsPerUnit = category value shown under that category in the final scoring area (or on its covering tile).

categories.label: Final: Evolution
categories.hint: units = feature markers on your feature spaces; pointsPerUnit = category value in the final scoring area.

categories.label: Final: Prosperity
categories.hint: units = active diamonds (food: 1 per 3 markers; money: 1 per 2 markers; settlements; storage); pointsPerUnit = category value.

categories.label: Final: Population
categories.hint: units = your tribes on the continent; pointsPerUnit = category value.

categories.label: Final: Expansion
categories.hint: units = territories where you have at least one tribe; pointsPerUnit = category value.

categories.label: Console stage partition
categories.hint: Each installed card/chip scores the points shown left of its stage (stage 4/5 only if that stage tile is flipped active; income chip is 7 in stage 4 if active).

categories.label: Point-bonus cards
categories.hint: Each card and income chip in the column of a point-bonus research card scores that card's printed value (the bonus card itself included).

categories.label: Module upgrades carried out (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số lần nâng cấp module (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: First tiebreaker: more module upgrades wins.

tiebreakers.description: Tied civilization with more module upgrades carried out wins
If still tied, the tied civilization that comes first in seating order wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Success points are advanced on a score track during play (immediate rewards, era scoring of 4 random categories, statues); enter that running total as trackScore (add 100 per lap). Final scoring then scores all 9 categories with the per-unit value printed on the board (or on the covering scoring tile), then the console stage partition, then point-bonus cards. Per-unit values vary per game so they are scorer inputs. Solo (V.I.C.I automa) and Alternate-Loop expansion not modelled.
